messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: main pipeline failed after merge — job `smoke-gpu-matrix` #482 failed at step `smoke-gpu`. link: <https://ci.redwood.internal/runs/4202589001>

maya: thanks for the ping. pinging owners — @vlad @jamal can one of you grab this?

vlad: I can take a look. I noticed a merge around 09:11 that touched allocator/prefetch sizing (PR #7246 by @nina).

jamal: I'll rerun the smoke-gpu job to rule out transient infra. prefer to isolate shard 3.

ci-bot: Rerun requested by jamal: <https://ci.redwood.internal/runs/4202589001/rerun/1>

maya: if rerun still red we should bisect main~5..main and check for node OOMs. also check kernel logs.

vlad: quick tail of the failing log I grabbed:

```
E2026-03-18 09:24:12.123 kernel: kvalloc: shard 3 reserve failed: requested 1.2GiB, available 220MiB
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File \"inference/runtime/alloc.py\", line 87, in reserve_kv
    raise RuntimeError(\"KV allocation failed\")
RuntimeError: KV allocation failed
```

ashley: could be allocator regression from the recent change. tagging @nina who authored the PR.

nina: saw CI green in a few runs locally; I changed prefetch size but didn't touch the scheduler. standing by to help debug.

ci-bot: Rerun completed: still red on shard 3. <https://ci.redwood.internal/runs/4202589001/rerun/1> :x: 

maya: ok. vlad, can you start a bisect? if PR#7246 is suspect, try reverting it in a canary first.

vlad: starting bisect now — pulling the two candidate commits and running a minimal reproducer locally. will update in ~20m :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

jamal: queued a hot rerun for only shard 3 on a larger instance type to see if it's infra (memory pressure). link: <https://ci.redwood.internal/runs/4202589001/rerun/2>

ci-bot: Hot rerun finished: passed on larger instance, failed on standard instance. logs show memory threshold hit earlier on standard.

maya: looks like allocator behaviour + infra memory pressure. plan: create revert PR for #7246 from main, run full pipeline. if revert fixes it, promote revert and open incident for follow-up. @ashley can you prepare the revert?

ashley: on it, creating revert PR now -> https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/7251

vlad: bisect confirms reproducer fails when prefetch size >= 64MB (introduced in PR #7246). probable root cause.

maya: great work. tagging oncall for follow-up and we'll schedule a short postmortem if revert lands. :thumbsup:
